ai_point_ledger_entry_direction_pair_che.name: ai_point_ledger_entry_direction_pair_check
ai_point_ledger_entry_direction_pair_che.value:
(
    ("ai_point_ledger_entries"."entry_type" IN ('grant', 'release', 'restore', 'merge_credit') AND "ai_point_ledger_entries"."direction" = 'credit')
    OR ("ai_point_ledger_entries"."entry_type" IN ('reserve', 'revoke', 'expire', 'merge_debit') AND "ai_point_ledger_entries"."direction" = 'debit')
    OR ("ai_point_ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'settle' AND "ai_point_ledger_entries"."direction" = 'neutral')
  )

apple_notification_events_lease_check.name: apple_notification_events_lease_check
apple_notification_events_lease_check.value:
(
    ("apple_notification_events"."locked_at" IS NULL AND "apple_notification_events"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "apple_notification_events"."lease_until" IS NULL)
    OR ("apple_notification_events"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "apple_notification_events"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "apple_notification_events"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
  )

apple_revocable_credentials_lease_check.name: apple_revocable_credentials_lease_check
apple_revocable_credentials_lease_check.value:
(
    ("apple_revocable_credentials"."revoke_lease_token" IS NULL AND "apple_revocable_credentials"."revoke_lease_until" IS NULL)
    OR ("apple_revocable_credentials"."revoke_lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "apple_revocable_credentials"."revoke_lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
  )

ops_entitlement_adjustments_values_check.name: ops_entitlement_adjustments_values_check
ops_entitlement_adjustments_values_check.value: "ops_entitlement_adjustments"."membership_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 366 AND "ops_entitlement_adjustments"."ai_points" BETWEEN 0 AND 100000 AND ("ops_entitlement_adjustments"."membership_days" > 0 OR "ops_entitlement_adjustments"."ai_points" > 0)

phone_otp_intents_account_check.name: phone_otp_intents_account_check
phone_otp_intents_account_check.value:
(
    ("phone_otp_intents"."purpose" IN ('login', 'password_recovery') AND "phone_otp_intents"."account_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("phone_otp_intents"."purpose" IN ('account_delete', 'phone_binding') AND "phone_otp_intents"."account_id" IS NOT NULL)
  )

recent_auth_grants_reservation_check.name: recent_auth_grants_reservation_check
recent_auth_grants_reservation_check.value:
(
    ("recent_auth_grants"."reservation_token" IS NULL AND "recent_auth_grants"."reservation_expires_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("recent_auth_grants"."reservation_token" IS NOT NULL AND "recent_auth_grants"."reservation_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
  )

sms_delivery_attempts_state_time_check.name: sms_delivery_attempts_state_time_check
sms_delivery_attempts_state_time_check.value:
(
    ("sms_delivery_attempts"."status" = 'completed' AND "sms_delivery_attempts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("sms_delivery_attempts"."status" <> 'completed' AND "sms_delivery_attempts"."completed_at" IS NULL)
  )
